title: Aspiring filmmaker here. I need help with something.

commenti.body:
This is a very tough choice. 

I love road trip movies and sad movies and Somewhere With Elephants sounds like a good combination of the two.

But I also like movies that are fantastical and Garden of Whispers sounds like it'll have lots of strange, trippy imagery and a dark fantasy tone. And the story is incredibly original. Also, like I said, I like sad movies and Garden of Whispers sounds like it could be very emotionally impactful, depending upon which classic poems are chosen and the personality and history of the people reciting them; and of course on what the young woman's dark secret is.

So it's a very tough choice but in the end I have to go with Garden of Whispers. But I'd love to see both.
